$comment: Jackie's compact on-device model queue. Source of truth for /models and scripts/download_models.py.

models.name: SmolLM2-360M-Instruct
models.note: The official GGUF repo only ships q8_0; use a community quant (e.g. bartowski) if you need q4_k_m.

models.name: gemma-3-1b-it
models.note: The 1B model is text-only. Image input starts at Gemma 3 4B (gemma-3-4b-it). Accept the Gemma terms on the Hub first.

models.name: opt-125m
models.note: Released under Meta's OPT license. Review the terms before you ship it.

models.name: MobileLLM-125M
models.note: Gated on the Hub and licensed for non-commercial research (FAIR NC).

models.name: MobileLLM-350M
models.note: Gated on the Hub and licensed for non-commercial research (FAIR NC).

models.name: MobileLLM-600M
models.note: Gated on the Hub and licensed for non-commercial research (FAIR NC).

models.name: Cerebras-GPT-111M
models.note: The Hub organization is lowercase `cerebras`.

models.name: Cerebras-GPT-590M
models.note: The Hub organization is lowercase `cerebras`.

models.name: mamba-130m
models.note: This is the native mamba_ssm checkpoint. For 🤗 Transformers use state-spaces/mamba-130m-hf.

models.name: mamba-370m
models.note: This is the native mamba_ssm checkpoint. For 🤗 Transformers use state-spaces/mamba-370m-hf.

models.name: rwkv-4-169m-pile
models.note: llama.cpp supports GGUF for RWKV-6/7, not RWKV-4. Run RWKV-4 natively or through rwkv.cpp.

models.name: rwkv-4-430m-pile
models.note: llama.cpp supports GGUF for RWKV-6/7, not RWKV-4. Run RWKV-4 natively or through rwkv.cpp.

models.name: stablelm-2-1_6b
models.note: The repo name uses an underscore (`1_6b`). Covered by the Stability AI Community License, so check the commercial terms.

models.name: bloomz-560m
models.note: BigScience RAIL license (use-based restrictions).

models.name: bloomz-1b1
models.note: BigScience RAIL license (use-based restrictions).

models.name: OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct
models.note: There is no OLMo-300M. OLMo 2 1B is the smallest OLMo, and the substitute here.

models.name: granite-3.0-2b-instruct
models.note: IBM publishes Granite under the `ibm-granite` organization.

models.name: bert-tiny
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: bert_uncased_L-2_H-128_A-2
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: bert_uncased_L-2_H-256_A-4
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: bert_uncased_L-4_H-256_A-4
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: albert-base-v2
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: TinyBERT_General_4L_312D
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: distilbert-base-uncased
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: mobilebert-uncased
models.note: MobileBERT is published by Google, not Microsoft. This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: multilingual-MiniLMv2-L6-mnli-xnli
models.note: No Multi-BERT-L-2 checkpoint exists. This is the smallest multilingual NLI model from the same author.

models.name: bart-large-mnli
models.note: This is the largest router here. distilbert-mnli is the compact zero-shot option.

models.name: deberta-v3-small
models.note: This is a pretrained encoder with no task head. Fine-tune it on your own labels before you route with it.

models.name: faster-whisper-base
models.note: faster-whisper is a runtime. Its CTranslate2 checkpoints are published as Systran/faster-whisper-{tiny,base,small,medium,large-v3}.

models.name: spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb
models.note: SpeechBrain checkpoint. Export it to ONNX yourself; the repo ships no ONNX file.

models.name: unispeech-sat-base-plus-sv
models.note: unispeech-sat-base is the pretrain-only backbone. The -plus-sv checkpoint carries the speaker-verification head.

models.name: musicgen-small
models.note: Weights are CC-BY-NC 4.0, so not for commercial use.

models.name: piper-voices
models.note: The repo holds hundreds of voices, so the queue only fetches en_US/lessac/medium. Edit `include` to add more. Each voice has its own MODEL_CARD and license.

models.name: XTTS-v2
models.note: Covered by the Coqui Public Model License, which is non-commercial. Coqui shut down in early 2024, so the model is unmaintained.

models.name: silero-vad
models.note: snakers4/silero-vad is the GitHub code repo, not a Hub model. The ONNX weights are mirrored at onnx-community/silero-vad.

models.name: wav2vec2-base-superb-er
models.note: s3prl/uper-emo does not exist on the Hub. This is the SUPERB (s3prl) emotion-recognition port with 4 classes: neutral, happy, angry and sad.

models.name: wav2vec2-large-voxrex
models.note: This is a Swedish-pretrained wav2vec2 and not a speaker model. For speaker features use ecapa-voxceleb or unispeech-sat-base-plus-sv.

models.name: YOLOv5n
models.note: This is not a Hub model repo. Get yolov5n.pt from the GitHub releases, or `pip install ultralytics` and load YOLO('yolov5nu.pt'). Ultralytics weights and code are AGPL-3.0. Closed-source distribution needs an Ultralytics Enterprise license.

models.name: YOLOv8n
models.note: yolov8n.pt lives in the Ultralytics/YOLOv8 repo. Export with `yolo export model=yolov8n.pt format=onnx|tflite|coreml`. Ultralytics weights and code are AGPL-3.0. Closed-source distribution needs an Ultralytics Enterprise license.

models.name: YOLO11n
models.note: The model is named YOLO11, with no 'v'. Weights are yolo11n.pt in the Ultralytics/YOLO11 repo. Ultralytics weights and code are AGPL-3.0. Closed-source distribution needs an Ultralytics Enterprise license.

models.name: MobileNetV3-Small
models.note: Google never published a MobileNetV3 checkpoint on the Hub. The canonical weights are in timm, and an ONNX build is in onnx-community.

models.name: vit-tiny-patch16-224
models.note: Google only published ViT base and larger on the Hub. This is the community port of timm's ViT-Tiny.

models.name: tf_efficientnet_lite0.in1k
models.note: There is no google/efficientnet-lite0 on the Hub. This is the TF-trained checkpoint ported to timm. The TFLite build ships through Kaggle Models / TF Hub.

models.name: efficientnet_b0.ra_in1k
models.note: timm repos carry a pretrained-tag suffix.

models.name: convnextv2_atto.fcmae_ft_in1k
models.note: timm repos carry a pretrained-tag suffix.

models.name: mobilevitv2_050.cvnets_in1k
models.note: timm repos carry a pretrained-tag suffix.

models.name: mobilevit-small
models.note: Released under Apple's sample-code license, so review it before you redistribute.

models.name: mit-b0
models.note: Covered by the NVIDIA Source Code License for SegFormer, which is non-commercial.

models.name: MobileSAM
models.note: ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM is the GitHub code repo. Weights are mirrored on the Hub (dhkim2810/MobileSAM) and at download.pytorch.org/models/mobilesam/mobile_sam.pt.

models.name: depth-anything-small-hf
models.note: Depth Anything v1 is published under LiheYoung. The `depth-anything` org hosts v2 only.

models.name: Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf
models.note: The -hf repo is the 🤗 Transformers layout, which exports cleanly to ONNX/Core ML. The non-hf repo holds the raw .pth for the original codebase. Only Small is Apache-2.0; Base/Large are CC-BY-NC.

models.name: dpt-beit-base-384
models.note: The repo name includes the input resolution (`-384`).

models.name: dpt-hybrid-midas
models.note: isl-org/MiDaS is the GitHub code repo. The MiDaS v3 hybrid weights are on the Hub as Intel/dpt-hybrid-midas.

models.name: RTMDet-tiny
models.note: This lives in the MMDetection model zoo, not on the Hub. Export it to ONNX with mmdeploy.

models.name: Florence-2-base
models.note: Florence-2 has no 'small' size. Base (0.23B) is the smallest and Large (0.77B) is next.

models.name: Florence-2-large
models.note: Takes Phase 2's Florence-2-base slot, because base moved up to Phase 1 to replace the non-existent 'small'.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
models.note: The 3B checkpoint uses the Qwen Research License, which is non-commercial. The 7B is Apache-2.0. GGUF also needs the mmproj file.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
models.note: GGUF also needs the mmproj file.

models.name: Phi-3.5-vision-instruct
models.note: Canonical repo casing is `Phi-3.5-vision-instruct`.

models.name: Emu3-Chat
models.note: There is no Emu3-Vision repo. Emu3 ships as Emu3-Chat (understanding), Emu3-Gen (generation) and Emu3-VisionTokenizer. At about 8B it is not a compact model.

models.name: blip-image-captioning-base
models.task: Image captioning and asset lineage captions
models.note: Salesforce/blip-base does not exist, so the base captioner is used. Queue rows #158 and #173 were the same model.

models.name: layoutlmv3-base
models.note: Weights are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so not for commercial use.

models.name: PP-OCR mobile
models.note: PP-OCR mobile det/rec models are distributed from PaddleOCR's model list. Convert them with paddle2onnx.

models.name: tiny-sd
models.note: CreativeML OpenRAIL-M license (use-based restrictions).

models.name: sd-turbo
models.note: Covered by the Stability AI Community License, so check the commercial terms.

models.name: sdxl-turbo
models.note: Covered by the Stability AI Community License. The downloader keeps fp16 weights only.
